CustomBossChallenge-CustomBossChallenge: Adds a Boss Creator to the main menu: the Challenge Editor with boss options. Pick any boss (or Elite), change its speed, health and skulls, play 1 to 10 tiers on the rounds you choose, and combine it with every Challenge Editor rule. Custom games are always unranked and never touch your records or saves.
CustomBossChallenge-BossTypeInfo: Choose which boss to fight. Tick Elite to fight the much stronger Elite version of the boss.
CustomBossChallenge-BossSpeedInfo: How fast the boss moves, in percent of its normal speed. 100 % is the normal speed.
CustomBossChallenge-BossHealthInfo: How much health the boss has, in percent of its normal health. Applies to every tier.
CustomBossChallenge-AllFortifiedInfo: Makes every bloon that can be fortified fortified, so leads, ceramics and MOAB-class bloons are much tougher.
CustomBossChallenge-MaxParagonsInfo: How many paragons you can have at the same time. 0 means no paragons. Drag the slider all the way to the right for no limit.
CustomBossChallenge-BossTiersInfo: How many tiers of the boss you have to defeat, from 1 to 10. Each tier is stronger than the one before. You win when the last tier is defeated. Tiers above 5 are copies of tier 5 with more health.
CustomBossChallenge-SpeedPerTierInfo: Adds this share of the normal speed for every tier after the first, on top of the game's own steps: +20 % makes tier 2 ×1.2, tier 3 ×1.4 and so on. Below 0 makes later tiers slower.
CustomBossChallenge-HealthPerTierInfo: Adds this share of the normal health for every tier after the first, on top of the game's own steps: +100 % makes tier 2 ×2, tier 3 ×3 and so on. Tiers above 5 already get +50 % each. 0 % keeps the normal health.
CustomBossChallenge-TierPreviewInfo: Every tier with the round it arrives on, its speed compared to the normal game and its health. Orange is more than the normal game, blue is less.
CustomBossChallenge-SpawnRoundsInfo: The round each tier arrives on, separated by commas, e.g. 40, 60, 80. Missing rounds continue every 20 rounds. The game's last round is moved to after the last tier so every tier can be played.
CustomBossChallenge-SkullsInfo: Skulls are points on the boss's health bar where it uses its special ability. Vanilla keeps the normal skulls, Evenly Spaced spreads a number of skulls over the health bar and Custom % puts them at the health percentages you choose.
CustomBossChallenge-SkullCountInfo: How many evenly spaced skulls the boss has. 0 removes all skulls.
CustomBossChallenge-SkullHealthInfo: The health percentages where the skulls are, separated by commas, e.g. 80, 60, 40, 20.
CustomBossChallenge-ShareCodeInfo: Copy puts this whole setup, boss options and Challenge Editor rules, on the clipboard as a code you can paste into Discord, Reddit or a message. Paste loads a code someone shared with you.
CustomBossChallenge-CodeCopied: Code copied to the clipboard ({0} characters). Paste it anywhere to share this boss.
CustomBossChallenge-LoadCodeQuestion: Load this setup? Your current setup will be replaced.
CustomBossChallenge-CodeInvalid: The clipboard doesn't contain a Boss Creator code. Copy the whole code, starting with CBC
CustomBossChallenge-CodeTooNew: This code comes from a newer version of Custom Boss Challenge. Update the mod to load it.
CustomBossChallenge-UnsupportedMode: The {0} game mode can't be used for boss games.
CustomBossChallenge-BossUnavailable: This boss can't be played: the game has no {0} bloon. A game update may have changed it.
